core_obligations: For x in (eta_f M)^i write x = f^i x' with x' in M^i, so that d^i(x) = f^{i+1} y for some y, and conclude that d^i maps x' tensor f^i to zero in M^{i+1} tensor f^iA/f^{i+1}A (proof lines 27753-27756).

Map x to the class of x' tensor f^i in H^i(M^bullet tensor f^iA/f^{i+1}A) and check that this rule defines a map (eta_f M)^i tensor A/fA -> H^i(M^bullet tensor f^iA/f^{i+1}A) of A/fA-modules (proof lines 27757-27764).

Verify compatibility with differentials by viewing x' tensor f^i as an element of M^i tensor f^iA/f^{i+2}A with d^i(x' tensor f^i) = y tensor f^{i+1}, and using the construction of beta to get beta(x' tensor f^i) = y tensor f^{i+1}, so that the maps form a map of complexes (proof lines 27765-27771).

Identify the constructed maps with the maps (eta_f M)^i tensor A/fA -> Z^i/B^i discussed earlier, and use that their kernel is an acyclic subcomplex of eta_f M^bullet tensor A/fA to conclude that the map of complexes is a quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 27774-27779).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a ring A, a nonzerodivisor f in A and a complex M^bullet of f-torsion free A-modules, and asserts that there is a canonical map of complexes from eta_f M^bullet tensor_A A/fA to the complex H^bullet(M^bullet/f) defined by the Bockstein equations, and that this map is a quasi-isomorphism (source lines 27738-27750). The proof is an explicit degreewise computation. For x in (eta_f M)^i one writes x = f^i x' with x' in M^i, so that d^i(x) = f^{i+1} y, and therefore d^i sends x' tensor f^i to zero in M^{i+1} tensor f^iA/f^{i+1}A; this lets the proof map x to the class of x' tensor f^i in H^i(M^bullet tensor f^iA/f^{i+1}A), and the proof checks that this rule defines a map of A/fA-modules (proof lines 27753-27764). Compatibility with differentials is then verified by regarding x' tensor f^i as an element of M^i tensor f^iA/f^{i+2}A with differential d^i(x' tensor f^i) = y tensor f^{i+1}, so that the construction of beta gives beta(x' tensor f^i) = y tensor f^{i+1} and the maps therefore commute with differentials (proof lines 27765-27771). The quasi-isomorphism statement is finished by identifying the constructed maps with the maps (eta_f M)^i tensor A/fA -> Z^i/B^i discussed earlier and using that the kernel of those maps is an acyclic subcomplex of eta_f M^bullet tensor A/fA (proof lines 27774-27779). The non-routine content is the degreewise bookkeeping with the shifted tensor factors and the identification with the previously studied maps.
